perks.name: Subsistence

perks.name: Perpetual Motion

perks.name: Demolitionist

perks.name: Rampage

perks.name: Kill Clip

perks.name: High-Impact Reserves
perks.desc: Rounds at the end of the magazine deal more damage.

perks.name: Opening Shot
perks.desc: Improved accuracy and range on the opening shot of attack.

perks.name: Headseeker
perks.desc: Body shots landed with this weapon increase precision damage and aim assist for a short time. Body shots landed while the perk is active refresh the time.

perks.name: Kinetic Tremors

perks.name: Firefly

perks.name: Sword Logic
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage. The strength and duration of the bonus increases when more powerful targets are defeated.

perks.name: Desperado
perks.desc: Reloading after a precision final blow or after rapidly defeating targets increases your rate of fire.

perks.name: Frenzy
perks.desc: Being in combat for an extended time increases damage, handling, and reload for this weapon until you are out of combat.

perks.name: All-Star
perks.desc:
Collecting ammo loads this weapon from reserves and enhances its damage and reload speed for a duration.

Collecting Heavy ammo grants more time.

perks.name: Closing Time
perks.desc: Improves range, accuracy, and handling as the magazine gets lower.

perks.name: Kill Clip
perks.desc: Reloading after a kill grants increased damage.

perks.name: Desperate Measures
perks.desc: Weapon final blows grant bonus damage. Melee and grenade final blows grant a larger damage bonus that can stack.

perks.name: Vorpal Weapon
perks.desc: Increased damage against bosses, vehicles, and Guardians with their Super active.

perks.name: Eye of the Storm
perks.desc: This weapon becomes more accurate and boosts handling as your health gets lower.

perks.name: High Ground
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon grant stacks of bonus damage. Attacking targets from higher ground immediately grants the maximum number of stacks.

perks.name: Osmosis
perks.desc: Using your grenade ability partially refills the magazine and changes this weapon's damage type to match your grenade until you stow it.

perks.name: Full Auto Trigger System
perks.desc: Holding down the trigger will fire this weapon at full auto.

perks.name: Outlaw
perks.desc: Precision kills greatly decrease reload time.

perks.name: Slideshot
perks.desc: Sliding partially reloads this weapon's magazine and temporarily boosts range and stability.

perks.name: Under Pressure
perks.desc: Improved stability and accuracy as the magazine gets lower.

perks.name: Gun and Run
perks.desc: Defeating targets builds stacks of Gun and Run for a short duration. Sprinting for a short time consumes a stack to partially reload this weapon's magazine from reserves; on Bows, this briefly improves draw speed.

notes: Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 124 from 19 November 2024 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/3n08KP410ui1TXoEdBmsvu?si=2badf5a8fcac408d) with @Saint_Kabr, @ImpetusAlways and @CourtProjects (PvE PvE-MinorSpec PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE pick use for add clearing in general, and end-game underleveled content. Bygones has been a PvP fan favourite for a long time, there's a few possible rolls that make a decent choice for a kinetic slot pulse rifle. It does drop from Gambit activities with a 12×12 trait perk pool, so if you're after it, reset your Zavala rank as many times as you're able before focusing. At base the stats are good - 48 Range equates to 33.32m range when ADS and 19.60m hipfire, 46 Handling is 0.40s ready, 0.37s ADS and 0.39s stow speed, while the Reload Speed of 46 is a 1.94s reload. On controllers, you'll find that straightening the recoil or boosting stability will help with control - on M+KB handling is the more obvious play for the barrel perk. The combat effect magazine perks, or something that helps reload work well too. There's a useful synergy between both Shoot to Loot and Attrition Orbs, and Kinetic Tremors shockwaves. Shoot to Loot will pick up any ammo bricks (and reload all your weapons) as well as orbs in the shockwave's area, while Attrition Orbs can be triggered by the shockwave to generate orbs faster. The Gun and Run origin trait is a bit meh, TBH but it's there anyway. Recommended MW: any - dealer's choice with a Backup Mag mod or, when masterworked, Synergy to create power orbs or Stunloader when there's a matching artifact mod.

Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 124 from 19 November 2024 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/3n08KP410ui1TXoEdBmsvu?si=2badf5a8fcac408d) with @Saint_Kabr, @ImpetusAlways and @CourtProjects (PvE PvE-MinorSpec PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE pick use for add clearing in general, and end-game underleveled content. Bygones has been a fan favourite for a long time, and is a very decent choice for a kinetic slot pulse rifle. It does drop from Gambit activities with a 12×12 trait perk pool, so if you're after it, reset your Zavala rank as many times as you're able before focusing. At base the stats are good - 48 Range equates to 33.32m range when ADS and 19.60m hipfire, 46 Handling is 0.40s ready, 0.37s ADS and 0.39s stow speed, while the Reload Speed of 46 is a 1.94s reload. On controllers, you'll find that straightening the recoil or boosting stability will help with control - on M+KB handling is the more obvious play for the barrel perk. The combat effect magazine perks, or something that helps reload work well too. If you're looking for an all-purpose roll, then Demolitionist is always useful as a first trait column perk. In the second column, you can match that with Frenzy for ×1.15 damage boost and maxed Handling and Reload Speed, or Desperate Measures for up to ×1.3 damage, using the grenade energy you're generating. The Gun and Run origin trait is a bit meh, TBH but it's there anyway. Recommended MW: any - dealer's choice with a Backup Mag mod or, when masterworked, Synergy to create power orbs or Stunloader when there's a matching artifact mod.

pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "Bygones is back and I'm sure a lot of Veteran players are happy. Bygones was one of those feel good weapons from Forsaken that never really got a proper replacement. Updated with more perks and an origin trait it can definitely find a solid place within your loadouts. Firefly is an interesting choice and allows for the best AoE. Pair that with Subsistence and you never have to reload. Kinetic Tremors is the best for single target damage with decent AoE and pairs best with Keep Away or Outlaw as you won't be killing as reliably if you proc Kinetic Tremors. Desperado will feel great if you can get it going and the obvious pairing is Outlaw for a faster proc." Recommended MW: Reload Speed.

pandapaxxy (PvP / Controller): "With the recent adjustment to High Ground (and in my humble opinion, it might get adjusted again) Bygones still two bursts with a clean 6 crit. I feel it's still a little overturned for such an easy payoff. If you're looking to get that roll you know what to look for. But outside of that roll you've got great neutral perks like Eye of the Storm, Headseeker, Zen Moment, and Keep Away. Kill Clip will always *just work* and doesn't need too much thought to keep going. Bygones still remains a top choice but it's a tad less forgiving now." Recommended MW: Stability.
